raw:
Time makes me cry,
Time makes smile,
Time hurts a lot when it passes,
Time hurts a lot when it doesn't pass,
Time give memories,
Time takes memories,

Time does everything,
But you don't do anything,
Time is taking everything from you,
You are in delusion of having everything.

Time is wrong it hurts and takes,
Blame time every moment of wake.
Blame but don't blame yourself
Cause you are not in control of yourself.

Your vision will blur,
Legs will feel heavy,
Breathing will be labored,
You'll be flowing with time but without yourself.

You'll forget,
Forget breathing
Forget walking
Forget seeing
Forget talking
You'll have memories of all times where you did nothing.
Your existence will be forgotten from friends, family, world and yourself,
What will remain is the suffocating past nothingness accumulated with time by you
And only for you.

Breathe in, breathe out,
Breathe in, breathe out,
You are capable of control,
You breathe in when you want,
You breathe out when you want.

Don’t focus on just wants,
But also see your needs,
Control your wants adjust your needs
Don’t control everything or you'll loose everything,
It's a balance of power on how much to control
Power is grown from experience,
Control your power and grow it larger
Diversify and learn different things
Rely more on yourself not on your things,
You could once calculate 5783 x 23 in your mind,
You gave up control now you rely on a tool
Take back that control and rebuild yourself.

You are a pitiful memory almost dead,
You still can't take control,
You are still here reading this bluff,
If you'd taken control you would have focused on a progressing yet here you are.
Best of luck next time looser!
refined:
Time makes me cry,
Time makes me smile,
Time hurts when it passes,
Time hurts when it doesn't pass.
Time gives memories,
Time takes memories,
Time does everything —
But you don't do anything.
Time is taking everything from you,
You are in the delusion of having everything.
Time is wrong — it hurts and takes,
Blame time for every waking moment.
Blame, but don't blame yourself —
Because you are not in control of yourself.
Your vision will blur,
Your legs will feel heavy,
Breathing will be labored —
You'll be flowing with time, but without yourself.
You'll forget —
Forget breathing,
Forget walking,
Forget seeing,
Forget talking.
You'll have memories of every moment you spent without control.
Your existence will be forgotten — by friends, by family,
by the world, and by yourself.
What will remain is the suffocating past nothingness
accumulated with time, by you,
and only for you.

Breathe in, breathe out,
Breathe in, breathe out.
You are capable of control —
You breathe in when you want,
You breathe out when you want.
Don't focus on just wants,
but also see your needs.
Control your wants, adjust your needs.
Don't control everything — or you'll lose everything.
It's a balance of control, knowing how much to hold.
Control is grown from experience.
Control your power and grow it larger.
Diversify, learn different things.
Rely more on yourself, not on your things.
You could once calculate 5783 × 23 in your mind.
You gave up control — now you rely on a tool.
Take back that control and rebuild yourself.

You are a pitiful existence, almost dead.
You still can't take control.
You are still here — reading this —
when you could have been doing something,
when you could have been taking control.
Best of luck next time, loser.
